title: FrontCore Cosmetics&Crates
description: A cosmetics add-on for FrontCore adding gun’s skins items and more
body:
**FC Cosmetics & Crates** is a content expansion addon for **FrontCore** focused on cosmetic progression, collection, and player customization. It adds systems such as gun skins, cosmetic items, themed collections, rarity-based rewards, and crate openings that give players more ways to build a unique visual identity in **BlockFront** without changing gameplay balance.

The addon is designed to make cosmetic content feel like a real part of progression rather than just a simple extra menu. Players can unlock, collect, preview, and equip a growing range of visual rewards that are organized into collections, categories, and rarity tiers. This gives the system more depth and makes every unlock feel like part of a larger collectible ecosystem.

Crates are built as an extension of the cosmetic system, adding an exciting reward-opening experience while staying aligned with a fair, play-to-win philosophy. The focus is on visual content, collection value, and long-term engagement, not gameplay advantage. Rewards are meant to feel satisfying, valuable, and worth chasing, while still fitting into a progression model where cosmetics remain part of the overall player journey.

The goal of **FC Cosmetics & Crates** is to expand the cosmetic side of **FrontCore** into a polished and rewarding content ecosystem. It gives players more style, more reasons to keep playing, and more ways to express themselves, while also creating a strong foundation for future progression, mission, and economy systems.
